properties.query:
SecurityEvent 
| where EventID == 4769 
// Extract needed fields from XML when not parsed as columns 
| extend TicketEncryptionType = extract(@"<Data Name=""TicketEncryptionType"">([^<]+)</Data>", 1, EventData) 
| extend TicketOptions        = extract(@"<Data Name=""TicketOptions"">([^<]+)</Data>", 1, EventData) 
| extend ServiceName          = coalesce(ServiceName, extract(@"<Data Name=""ServiceName"">([^<]+)</Data>", 1, EventData)) 
| extend TargetUserName       = coalesce(TargetUserName, extract(@"<Data Name=""TargetUserName"">([^<]+)</Data>", 1, EventData)) 
| extend IpAddress            = coalesce(IpAddress, extract(@"<Data Name=""IpAddress"">([^<]+)</Data>", 1, EventData)) 
// Normalize common values 
| extend TicketEncryptionType = tostring(TicketEncryptionType) 
| extend TicketOptions        = tostring(TicketOptions) 
| extend IpAddress            = iff(IpAddress startswith "::ffff:", substring(IpAddress, 7), IpAddress) 
// Filtering logic 
| where isnotempty(TicketEncryptionType) and isnotempty(TicketOptions) 
| where TicketEncryptionType in ("0x17")    // RC4 
| where TicketOptions == "0x40810010"              // suspicious combo seen in tooling 
| where ServiceName !contains "$"                  // avoid machine accounts 
| summarize TotalRequests = count(), 
            DistinctIPs = dcount(IpAddress), 
            IPs = make_set(IpAddress, 10) 
          by TargetUserName, ServiceName, TicketEncryptionType, TicketOptions, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h) 
| where TotalRequests > 5
